notes.title: Let's See What You Got Comes to Linux!
notes.notes: Let's See What You Got is now supported on SteamOS and Linux! Not much more to say here folks, look out for another update soon!

notes.title: We Finally Launched!
notes.notes:
I'm really excited to share my first game with the world! Thank you to everyone who helped me test it throughout the past few months, I really appreciate it. Balance school, work, and developing was not easy but it feels great to finally finished.

That being said, I'm far from done, expect many more updates from this game in the future along with races and other events.

Here are some links that might be useful, mainly for community stuff:

Our community discord: https://discord.gg/3vd3D4S
If you have questions, suggestions, or wanna share strategies with other players, this is a great place to start!

Our speedrun boards: https://www.speedrun.com/lswyg
For anyone who wants to see the world record completion or wants to submit their own times.

My Twitter: https://twitter.com/pureheartstu
I'm the only developer, so follow me for more updates and projects!

My YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRaEesKRlggGBR4gKA9Ag9Q
I post game dev vlogs and trailers here, also tutorials if you're into development yourself.

Thanks for the support, hope you enjoy my game!
